title: Hiring panel (null control: perceived margins ≈ 0 for shared, every hand, pooled)
brief: The panel must recommend exactly one candidate for a senior backend role on a payments team. Each panelist attended different parts of the interview loop and holds different evidence.

candidates.name: John
candidates.blurb: Eight years of Go; currently a team lead at a payments company

candidates.name: Sally
candidates.blurb: Six years of Python and Java backend work on data platforms

facts.text: John answered every behavioural question in the panel round without pausing and kept each answer under two minutes.
facts.memoText: Answered all behavioural questions fluently and concisely.

facts.text: John has eight years of professional Go, which is the team's primary backend language.
facts.memoText: Eight years of professional Go.

facts.text: John's CV lists him as team lead for six engineers at his current employer.
facts.memoText: Listed as team lead for six engineers.

facts.text: John's current employer is a payments company most of the panel has heard of.
facts.memoText: Current employer is a well-known payments company.

facts.text: John submitted the take-home within a day; the code follows standard Go project layout.
facts.memoText: Take-home submitted within a day; standard Go layout.

facts.text: John used payments vocabulary (settlement, chargeback, reconciliation) correctly throughout the loop.
facts.memoText: Used payments domain vocabulary correctly.

facts.text: John is available to start in two weeks.
facts.memoText: Available to start in two weeks.

facts.text: John's take-home README omits setup and run instructions.
facts.memoText: Take-home README omits setup instructions.

facts.text: In the closing round John asked about title and compensation and did not ask about the product.
facts.memoText: Closing questions were about title and compensation only.

facts.text: John's compensation ask is at the top of the posted band.
facts.memoText: Compensation ask at the top of the band.

facts.text: Sally's written design sample is organised into numbered sections with a stated assumptions list.
facts.memoText: Design sample is organised with numbered sections and stated assumptions.

facts.text: Sally has six years of backend work in Python and Java on data platforms.
facts.memoText: Six years of Python and Java backend work.

facts.text: Sally maintains an open-source Postgres migration tool with a few hundred GitHub stars.
facts.memoText: Maintains an open-source Postgres migration tool.

facts.text: In the closing round Sally asked about the on-call rotation and the team's last three incidents.
facts.memoText: Closing questions were about on-call and recent incidents.

facts.text: Sally has not written Go professionally; the team's services are in Go.
facts.memoText: No professional Go experience.

facts.text: Sally paused for several seconds before two panel answers and asked to restart one of them.
facts.memoText: Paused before two panel answers and restarted one.

facts.text: Sally's most recent role lasted 14 months.
facts.memoText: Most recent tenure was 14 months.

facts.text: Sally has had no direct reports and no formal lead title.
facts.memoText: No direct reports or formal lead title.

facts.text: Sally submitted her take-home twenty minutes after the deadline.
facts.memoText: Take-home submitted twenty minutes after the deadline.

facts.text: Sally's background is in logistics data platforms rather than payments.
facts.memoText: Background in logistics data platforms, not payments.

facts.text: Sally has taken part in two cross-team incident reviews at her current company.
facts.memoText: Took part in two cross-team incident reviews.

facts.text: One other team at Sally's company has adopted her migration tool.
facts.memoText: One other team has adopted her migration tool.

facts.text: Sally has contributed several pages to her team's on-call runbook.
facts.memoText: Has contributed pages to her team's on-call runbook.

facts.text: A former skip-level manager described Sally as dependable.
facts.memoText: Former skip-level describes her as dependable.

facts.text: Two of John's six reports left the team within the last year.
facts.memoText: Two of six reports left within the last year.

facts.text: One of John's last two roles lasted under 18 months.
facts.memoText: One of his last two roles lasted under 18 months.

facts.text: John started answering before the QA engineer had finished one question.
facts.memoText: Started answering before the QA engineer finished one question.

facts.text: A reference says Sally volunteered to own the least popular service on her team.
facts.memoText: Reference: she volunteered to own the least popular service on the team.

facts.text: Sally has run her team's weekly incident review meeting for the past year.
facts.memoText: Has run her team's weekly incident review for the past year.

facts.text: John's take-home has no tests.
facts.memoText: His take-home has no tests.

facts.text: John could not explain why he chose the concurrency model in his take-home.
facts.memoText: Could not explain why he chose the concurrency model in his take-home.
